description: Finds a venture firm's adviser registration on the SEC's IAPD by name: CRD, SEC number (801- registered, 802- exempt reporting adviser), status, office and other names, with the IAPD page and the Form ADV PDF. Assets under management is in the Form ADV (Item 5.F for a registered adviser, Section 7.B private-fund gross assets for an exempt reporting adviser) with its own as-of date; report it with that date and that basis, never as a fund size. Public records, read-only.
name: fundraising_search_sec_advisers
title: Search Sec Advisers
